security-review.notes: High-value guardrail skill, but the body is long and example-heavy. Keep the checklist, trim repetitive examples.

tdd-workflow.notes: Important default workflow. Shorten repeated coverage language and keep the RED-GREEN-REFACTOR core.

verification-loop.notes: Compact and clear. Good post-change checklist for both runtimes.

deployment-patterns.notes: Useful when explicitly needed, but too broad for default loading.

docker-patterns.notes: Keep as an opt-in infrastructure skill, not a default.

database-migrations.notes: Focused enough already. Strong candidate for explicit project use.

postgres-patterns.notes: Compact reference skill; safe to keep available but not default.

coding-standards.notes: Important, but it should be shorter and less generic.

frontend-patterns.notes: Useful for React work, but too large for always-on inclusion.

backend-patterns.notes: Useful for service work. Keep available, not default.

e2e-testing.notes: Project-specific and verbose; keep as opt-in.

api-design.notes: High value when designing APIs, but should stay off by default.

python-patterns.notes: Too long and too broad right now. Rewrite before using as a shared default.

python-testing.notes: Large and Python-specific. Needs a smaller, more tactical version.

search-first.notes: Clear trigger, low overhead, good default behavior.

strategic-compact.notes: Short, specific, and directly useful for long sessions.

eval-harness.notes: Strong for AI-heavy work, but advanced and not a default.

iterative-retrieval.notes: Compact and valuable for context-constrained workflows.
